headline: Fewer orders and more expensive accounts: the dilemma of restaurants in Mexico and the U.S.
summary: In Mexico and the US, restaurants are sustaining revenue through higher prices despite falling orders and irregular traffic. GLP-1 drug use is pushing demand toward smaller portions, forcing menu and margin adjustments.
why: Restaurant sales and margins are a useful gauge of consumer spending pressure and the health of the food-service sector.
original_headline: Menos pedidos y cuentas más caras: El dilema de los restaurantes en México y EU
